verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents first-party import paths: a direct Jira migration, a Trello import, and CSV import for other tools. The API also tracks the original IDs of imported entities, which shows import is built into the product. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on what data is mapped and migrated (stories, epics, users, history), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the import working.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over

citations.quote: Direct migration path from Jira, plus Trello import and CSV for other tools.
In the case that the Category has been imported from another tool, the ID in the other tool can be indicated here.
